json.description: Floating contact button. With no config the panel auto-discovers tel:/mailto: links from the page and adds a Send-a-message link to /contact/. All fields optional.

label.description: ARIA label and tooltip on the button itself.

panelTitle.description: Heading shown at the top of the open panel.

panelSubtitle.default: Pick the channel that suits you.

welcomeBubble.description: One-time chat-bubble teaser. Set to empty string to suppress.

welcomeBubbleDelay.description: Milliseconds after page load before the bubble appears.

hideOnPaths.description: Paths to hide the button on.

footer.description: Optional small footnote rendered below the action list.

actions.description: Override the auto-discovered action list entirely. Each entry: { kind, label, sublabel?, href, icon?, target? }.

prependActions.description: Insert custom actions above the auto-discovered list (e.g. a 'Book a call' calendar entry).

appendActions.description: Append custom actions below the auto-discovered list.
